reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Xarid predmetiga aloqasi bo'lmagan talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 4 platformaning standart shabloni bo'lib, yetkazib berish davriyligi va miqdoriga tegishli, lekin bu yerda 25 ball tovarga emas, affillanganlik, offshor hisobraqamlari va arbitraj yo'qligi haqidagi xatlar soniga (har biri 5 ball) beriladi. Bu ball ishtirokchi tovar yetkaza olish qobiliyatini emas, hujjatlar to'plamini baholaydi va stol anjomlarining sifat yoki narx jihatdan eng yaxshi taklifini aniqlashga xizmat qilmaydi.

Xarid predmetiga aloqasi bo'lmagan talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 5 shablon bo'yicha kafolatdan keyingi xizmatga tegishli, lekin bu yerda 20 ball bankdagi K2 va muddati o'tgan qarzdorlik yo'qligi hamda to'lovga qobiliyati haqidagi ma'lumotnomalarga beriladi. Bu 20 ball tovar yoki xizmat sifatiga emas, ishtirokchining bank holatiga bog'langan, 26 000 000 so'mlik oddiy xarid uchun nomutanosib bo'lishi mumkin.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 3 da 10 ball ishtirokchining omborida talab qilingan tovarlar bor ekanini fotosurat bilan ko'rsatishga bog'langan. Bu tovarni buyurtma bo'yicha yetkazib bera oladigan, ammo hozir omborida zaxirasi bo'lmagan ishtirokchini kamsitishi mumkin.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (2-bet): Texnik topshiriq hujjati sarlavhasida akvarel qog'ozi (Torshon) xaridi ko'rsatilgan, summalar esa 20 910 000 va 21 892 000 so'm deb yozilgan, lot esa stol anjomlari bo'yicha 26 000 000 so'm. Hujjatdagi mahsulot va summalar lotga mos kelmaydi, shuning uchun ishtirokchi nimani taklif qilishi aniq emas.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 9 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 56% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 44%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 1 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (platform criteria form): Criterion 4 is standard platform template wording about delivery frequency and quantity, but here its 25 points are awarded for the number of letters (affiliation, offshore accounts, no arbitration, 5 points each), not for anything about the tableware or the ability to deliver it. The points reward paperwork rather than the best offer for the goods.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (platform criteria form): Criterion 5 is template wording about after-warranty service, yet here its 20 points are awarded for bank certificates showing no K2 or overdue bank debt and solvency. The points depend on the bidder's banking position rather than on the goods or service, which looks out of proportion for a 26,000,000 UZS purchase.

Other clause that may limit competition (platform criteria form): In criterion 3, 10 points depend on showing by photo that the required goods are already in the bidder's warehouse. This may disadvantage a supplier who can deliver to order but does not hold stock today.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 2): The technical-specification document is titled for purchasing watercolour paper and quotes amounts of 20,910,000 and 21,892,000 UZS, while the lot is for tableware at 26,000,000 UZS. The product and sums in the document do not match the lot, so it is unclear what bidders must offer against.
In the customer's last 9 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 56% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 44%.
Note: 1 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.
